title: Causal-SAM-LLM: Large Language Models as Causal Reasoners for Robust Medical Segmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization across cross-scanner, cross-modality, and cross-anatomy medical imaging datasets (BTCV, CHAOS, AMOS, BraTS) to measure the model's reliance on spurious correlations and domain-specific imaging styles.
